items.prompt:
Half a prompt — the brackets are the real decisions:
"passenger seat, [sun low through the left window], [red headrest behind], [big dark rectangular sunglasses]..."
The sun has to come from the side, not the front. Side light rims the hair and one cheek, then drops the other half of the cabin into shadow. Front light would make it a portrait. Side light makes it a ride home.
"...[hoodie unzipped and slipped off one shoulder] over a [white tank]..."
One shoulder bare is the whole styling move. The brown zip hoodie stays in the frame so it still reads as "I was cold / I got in the car," not a styled tank shoot. White underneath keeps the skin and the flare readable.
"...[fingers soft against the cheek and jaw], [mouth in a small pout], [not smiling]..."
Hand on the face does two jobs: it fills the shadow side, and it sells boredom. She's not performing sunset. She's waiting in traffic with good light she didn't ask for.
"...[sunglasses large enough to hide the eyes], [road and sky faintly in the lenses]..."
Hide the eyes on purpose. In a car at golden hour, open eyes invite "look how pretty the light is." Covered eyes keep the mood: warm outside, unimpressed inside. The reflection in the lenses is the only landscape you need.
"...[Nostalgic Neg, heavy grain, soft highlight bloom from the flare]..."
Let the flare stay a little dirty. Clean digital sun looks like an ad. Aged bloom looks like a phone rolled down the window for one second.
The life part: most good car photos aren't about the destination. They're about the ten quiet minutes when nobody needs anything from you yet.
Prompt keys: passenger seat, golden-hour side light, red headrest, large dark rectangular sunglasses, white tank, brown zip hoodie off one shoulder, hand on jaw, soft pout, lens flare, Nostalgic Neg, film grain.

items.prompt:
Do: keep the dress simple and tight.
Black spaghetti straps, sweetheart with soft ruching, wrap hem. One colour, one silhouette. The flash does the styling; the dress just has to hold the light.
The life part: this is the walk between dinner and the next place, when you're already a little tired and still dressed for it. The photo is an interruption, not the plan.
Prompt keys: night street, on-camera flash, underexposed city bokeh, full body mid-stride, black spaghetti mini, black choker, white quilted vanity bag gold chain, black stiletto sandals, red manicure, Nostalgic Neg, heavy film grain.
